arabic text: YE DASTANE GHAM SUNO HAZRAT HUSSAINKI\nKARTA HOON MEIN BAYAN SHAHADAT HUSSAINKI
english translation text: NARRATION OF SORROWS\nLISTEN TO THE NARRATION OF SORROWS OF IMAM HUSSAIN\nI AM NARRATING INCIDENT OF THE MARTYRDOM OF HUSSAIN

arabic text: JO FATEMAKE ANKHOKE TARETHE WO HUSAIN – JO MUSTAFAKE RAJ-DULARETHE WO HUSAIN\nJO LADLE THE SHERE KHUDAKE WAHI HUSAIN – JO RAH PERTHE AHLE WAFAKE WAHI HUSAIN
english translation text: HE WAS THE APPLE OF FATEMAH’S EYE - HUSSAIN WAS THE BELOVED OF MUSTAFA\nHUSSAIN WAS THE BELOVED OF THE LION OF GOD - HE WAS THE EMBODIMENT OF LOYALTY

arabic text: JINKO NABI GALESE LAGATETHE WO HUSAIN – KANTHOPE APNE JINKO BITHATETHE WO HUSAIN
english translation text: THAT HUSSAIN WHOM THE PROPHET WOULD EMBRACE - THE HUSSAIN WHOM HE WOULD CARRY ON HIS SHOULDERS

arabic text: JINKO FARISHTE LORI SUNATE THE WO HUSAIN – JIBRAEL JINKA JULA JULATETHE WO HUSAIN
english translation text: THE HUSSAIN FOR WHOM THE ANGELS WOULD SING LULLABIES - THE SAME HUSSAIN WHOSE CRADLE WAS ROCKED BY JIBRAEL

arabic text: CHAHI KHUDASE BAKHSHISHE UMMAT HUSSAINE – BADLEMEKI KOOBUL SHAHADAT HUSSAINNE
english translation text: HE DESIRED FORGIVENESS (SHAFA’AT) FOR THE UMMAH - IN RETURN HUSSAIN ACCEPTED MARTYRDOM

arabic text: AEYSI PADI NAMAZ KE SAJDE ME SAR DIYA – HAKKE CHAMANKO KHUNSE SERAB KARDIYA\nYE SHANE ALLAH, ALLAH AZMAT HUSEINKI – KARTA HOON MEIN BAYAN SHAHADAT HUSAINKI
english translation text: WHAT A PRAYER HE PRAYED GIVING HIS HEAD IN PROSTRATION - HE WATERED THE GARDEN OF TRUTH WITH HIS BLOOD\nTHIS GRANDEUR ALLAH, ALLAH THE GREATNESS OF HUSSAIN - I AM NARRATING THE MARTYRDOM OF HUSSAIN

arabic text: YE DASTANE GHAM SUNO HAZRAT HUSSAINKI\nKARTA HOON MEIN BAYAN SHAHADAT HUSSAINKI
english translation text: LISTEN TO THE NARRATION OF SORROWS OF IMAM HUSSAIN\nI AM NARRATING INCIDENT OF THE MARTYRDOM OF HUSSAIN

arabic text: KHAT LIKHA KUFIONE HUSSAIN AAP AEYE – AAP AAKE LAJE DEENE KHUDAKI BACHAEYE\nNIKLE HUSSAIN GHARSE BADE BANKH PANKE SAATH – BATE BHATIJE BHANJE BHAI BAHENKE SAATH
english translation text: THE KUFANS WROTE LETTERS TO HUSSAIN TO COME, TO SAVE ISLAM\nWITH GREAT STATURE HUSSAIN LEFT HOME WITH HIS SONS, NEPHEWS, BROTHERS AND SISTERS

arabic text: JAB SAHILE FURATPE PAHONCHA YE KAFELA – TO NAHER PAR KHADA MILA LASHKAR YAZEEDKA
english translation text: WHEN THE CARAVAN REACHED THE BANKS OF FURAT, THEY FOUND THE ARMY OF YAZID WAITING FOR THEM

arabic text: IBNE ZIYAD AUR SHIMR WAHIN AYE SAMNE – KAHENE LAGE WO DONO SITAMGAR HUSAINSE\nTASLIM KIJIYE AAP KHILAFAT YAZEEDKI – CHAHEJO KHAIR KIJIYE BAYYAT YAZEEDKI
english translation text: IBNE ZIYAD AND SHIMR CONFRONTED THEM, SAID THE 2 TYRANTS TO HUSSAIN :\nACCEPT THE KHILAFAT OF YAZID - IF YOU DESIRE SAFETY PLEDGE ALLEGIANCE TO YAZID

arabic text: BOLE HUSSAIN MUJKO SHAHADAT KUBUL HAI – LEKIN NA TAKTE ZULMKI BAYYAT KUBUL HAI
english translation text: HUSSAIN SAID I WILL ACCEPT MARTYRDOM, BUT ALLEGIANCE TO THE THRONE OF TYRANNY IS UNACCEPTABLE

arabic text: SHARMAE MAUT DEKH KAR HIMMAT HUSSAINKI\nKARTA HOON MEIN BAYAN SHAHADAT HUSSAINKI
english translation text: EVEN DEATH FELT HUMILIATED UPON HUSSAIN’S COURAGE I AM NARRATING THE MARTYRDOM OF HUSSAIN\nI AM NARRATING INCIDENT OF THE MARTYRDOM OF HUSSAIN

arabic text: PHIR ZALIMONE NAHERPE PAHERA LAGADIYA – PANI NA AHLEBETE NABIKO ZARA DIYA\nPANIKO TARSE SAKIYE KAUSARKE LAADLE - YUN BHUKHE PYASE TIN DIN TAK SABHI RAHE
english translation text: THE TYRANTS THEN SEIZED THE RIVER - TO PREVENT WATER TO THE PROGENY OF THE PROPHET\nBELOVEDS OF KAUTHAR WERE TO BE DEPRIVED OF DRINK - THUS ALL REMAINED HUNGRY AND THIRSTY FOR 3 DAYS

arabic text: AYSE ME HAMLA KARDIYA FAUJE YAZIDNE – DEKHE GAYENA HUR-SE SITAM AHLE ZULMAKE
english translation text: THEN THE ARMY OF YAZID BEGAN THEIR OFFENSIVE - HUR COULD NOT BEAR TO SEE THE ATROCITIES OF THESE TYRANTS

arabic text: WO AMILE HUSAINSE LASHKARKO CHODKAR – PAHELE SHAHID HUR HUWE NAME HUSAIN PAR\nABBSAS KE BHI NAHERPE BAZU HUWE KALAM – RAHE KHUDAME NIKLA ALAMDARE HAQ KA DAM
english translation text: HE JOINED HUSSAIN BY LEAVING THE ARMY OF YAZID - HE WAS THE FIRST MARTYR IN THE NAME OF HUSSAIN\nABBAS’S ARMS WERE SEVERED ON THE BANKS OF FURAT - IN ALLAH’S PATH THE FLAG BEARER OF TRUTH LOST HIS LIFE

arabic text: KASIM KE KHUN SE SHADI JODA BANA KAFAN – HAQ PER SHAHID HO GAYE SHAIZADE YE HASSAN
english translation text: QASIM’S BLOOD TURNED THE BRIDAL ROBES IN TO SHROUD - MARTYRED ON THE PATH OF TRUTH WAS HASSAN’S SON

arabic text: AKBAR KA SINA PHAT GAYA BARCHI AL AMAAN – YOON HAQ PE HAM SHABIHE PAYAMBER NE DEDI JAAN\nZAINAB KE LAAL AUNO MUHHAMAD NE SAR DIYA – MAMU PE APNE AAPKO KURBAN KAR DIYA
english translation text: ALI AKBAR’S CHEST WAS TORN BY A SPEAR – ON THE PATH OF TRUTH WAS MARTYRED THE IMAGE OF THE PROPHET\nZAINAB’S BELOVED AUN & MUHAMMAD GAVE AWAY THEIR LIVES -THEY SACRIFICED THEMSELVES FOR THEIR UNCLE

arabic text: EK TEER KHAAKE ASGARE MASUM CHALBASE – UFF BAZU E HUSAINE MAZLUM CHALBASE
english translation text: ASGHAR ALSO PASSED AWAY TAKING AN ARROW ON HIS NECK – OH, THE STRENGTH OF HELPLESS HUSSAIN PASSED AWAY

arabic text: YOON KARBALA ME LOOT GAYEE DAULAT HUSSAINKI\nKARTA HOON MEIN BAYAN SHAHADAT HUSSAINKI
english translation text: THUS, HUSSAIN WAS DEPRIVED OF HIS FAMILY\nI AM NARRATING THE MARTYRDOM OF HUSSAIN

arabic text: JAB JANESAR SAREHI HAQ PER HUWE FIDA – KOYEE BACHANA ABIDE BIMAR KE SIWA\nBIKHAREPE LASH HARSHU HUWA WAQT ASRKA – MEHVE NAMAZ ASR HUWE EBNE MURTAZA
english translation text: WHEN ALL THE COMPANIONS OF HUSSAIN WERE SACRIFICED ON PATH OF TRUTH – NONE WAS ALIVE EXCEPT IMAM SAJJAD AS\nTHEIR CORPSES SCATTERED AT THE TIME OF ASR – WHEN IMAM HUSSAIN WAS ENGROSSED IN HIS AFTERNOON PRAYERS

arabic text: SAJDEME SARJO HAZRATE SHABBIRKA JUKA – AYSEME WARE SHIMRANE SHABBIR PAR KIYA
english translation text: AS IMAM WAS BOWED IN PROSTRATION – SHIMR ATTACKED SHABBIR

arabic text: HAIDER KE LAL BHUKHE PYASE HUWE SHAHID – SAJDEME MUSTAFAKE NAWASE HUWE SHAHID\nPHIR ZALIMO NE JISM SE SARKO JUDA KIYA – NEZEPE SAR CHADA DIYA HAZRAT HUSSAINKA
english translation text: HAIDER’S SON WAS MARTYRED HUNGRY & THIRSTY – MUSTAFA’S GRANDSON WAS MARTYRED IN PROSTRATION\nTHEN THE ENEMIES BEHEADED AND RAISED IMAM HUSAINS HEAD ON A SPEAR

arabic text: ABID KE HAATH PAONME ZANZIR DALDI – ZAINAB KE SARSE SHIMRANE CHADERBHI CHINLI
english translation text: THEY SHACKLED THE HANDS & FEET OF ABID – SHIMR SNATCHED THE VEIL (CHAADAR) FROM ZAINAB’S HEAD

arabic text: YOON KARBALAME AHLEBAITPE AYSA SITAM HUWA – TADPE ZAMIN AUR AASMA DARIYA RO PADA\nDILSE NA JAYEGA GHAME SHABBIR HASHRATAQ – HAR DIL KAREGA MATAME SHABBIR HASHR TAQ
english translation text: SUCH WERE THE ATROCITIES INFLICTED PROPHET’S PROGENY – THE EARTH TREMBLED AND THE SKIES WEPT\nTILL QAYAMAT, SORROWS OF SHABBIR SHALL NEVER LEAVE OUR HEART – TILL QAYAMAT, EVERY HEART WILL DO THE MAATAM OF SHABBIR

arabic text: ZINDA RAKHEGA HAQ KO YE JAZBA HUSSAINKA – AAYEGA YAAD AKHRI SAJDA HUSSAINKA
english translation text: HUSSAIN’S PASSION WILL KEEP ALIVE THE TRUTH – HUSSAIN’S LAST PROSTRATION WILL ALWAYS BE REMEMBERED

arabic text: YAAD AAYEGI PAYAM IBAADAT HUSSAIKI\nKARTA HOON MEIN BAYAN SHAHADAT HUSSAINKI
english translation text: PAYAAM (THE POET), HUSSAIN’S IBAADAT WILL ALWAYS BE REMEMBERED\nI AM NARRATING INCIDENT OF THE MARTYRDOM OF HUSSAIN
